2607.07117.title: Tree-of-Thoughts Reasoning for Text-to-Image In-Context Learning
2607.07117.paper_summary: In text-to-image in-context learning (T2I-ICL), a model has to infer a latent compositional pattern from fewshot demonstrations for generating a query image. Recent studies show that state-of-the-art multimodal large language models struggle with this setting, particularly due to limited compositional reasoning and sensitivity to prompt construction. In this work, we propose a Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) reasoning framework for T2I-ICL that introduces a multi-stage reasoning and selection layer that generates, evaluates, and selects among multiple candidate hypotheses before constructing the final prompt for image synthesis. By exploring alternative reasoning branches and selecting a coherent interpretation, the proposed approach mitigates prompt ambiguity and compositional errors. We implement the proposed approach in a complete ToT-T2IICL inference pipeline and evaluate it on the CoBSAT benchmark. Both qualitative and quantitative results show that structured multi-branch reasoning leads to more consistent and semantically aligned image generation compared to baseline and Chain-of-Thought prompting strategies, without any additional training or fine-tuning.
2607.07117.paper_summary_zh: 在文本到圖像的上下文學習 (T2I-ICL) 中，模型必須從少量示範中推斷潛在的組合模式，以生成查詢圖像。最近的研究顯示，最先進的多模態大型語言模型在這種情境下表現不佳，特別是由於組合推理的限制和對提示構建的敏感性。在這項工作中，我們提出了一個樹狀思維 (ToT) 推理框架，用於 T2I-ICL，該框架引入了一個多階段的推理和選擇層，該層在構建最終的圖像合成提示之前生成、評估和選擇多個候選假設。通過探索替代的推理分支並選擇一致的解釋，所提出的方法減輕了提示的模糊性和組合錯誤。我們在完整的 ToT-T2IICL 推理管道中實現了所提出的方法，並在 CoBSAT 基準上進行了評估。定性和定量結果均顯示，結構化的多分支推理相比於基線和思維鏈提示策略，導致了更一致且語義對齊的圖像生成，而無需任何額外的訓練或微調。
